programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Si Christophe Colomb découvre l'Amérique, c'est aussi grâce à Coda, qui change accidentellement le cap. Chargé d'une lettre pour Napoléon, il cause sans le vouloir la défaite française à Waterloo. Il est aussi mêlé au naufrage du Titanic, puis vole une orange dans un souk, déclenchant une poursuite… jusqu'à l'amour avec une danseuse du ventre.

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Dans le New York des années 30, Coda travaille sur l'Empire State Building, un job périlleux où il risque tout. À Babylone, il tente l'ascension de la tour de Babel pour se rapprocher de sa planète, mais le sommet reste hors d'atteinte. En pleine croisade, il échappe aux flèches des deux camps, puis en 1789, il pousse la foule à la Révolution !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Au XVIIIe siècle, poursuivi par des gardes, Coda est sauvé par des mousquetaires mais doit se déguiser en femme pour échapper à ses poursuivants. Sur la route 66, il inspire Hendrix mais se fait un ennemi. À la Zone 51, il tente de s'évader avec l'alien de Roswell. Capturé par des Vikings, il affronte loups et rivière, toujours en fuite !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Fuyant une gorgone, Coda s'écrase chez Léonard de Vinci, qui pourrait inventer une soucoupe pour lui. Après plusieurs vies perdues à tester ses inventions, Coda trouve refuge dans l'art. En Russie, il sauve Raspoutine. Dans un western, il affronte un bandit sans savoir tirer. Traqué par des morts-vivants, il se réfugie chez un vampire. Coda survivra-t-il ?

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Bagout trouve un cerf-volant que Grabouillon veut attraper, mais il s'envole sur le toit. Après des péripéties, Grabouillon tombe dans les orties. Ils essaient une tyrolienne, puis gonflent une piscine qui explose. Privés de télé, ils récupèrent un poste, mais Bagout, en voulant brancher l'électricité, est interrompu par une guêpe.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon décore un gâteau avec des bonbons et s'enfuit, Pétunia s'inquiète. Bagout fait un feu interdit, et Grabouillon le propage par accident, mais une pluie les sauve. En hiver, Grabouillon perd son téléphone dans la neige, qu'il retrouve grâce à la sonnerie. Une expérience ratée avec de la pâte à sel envahit la cuisine.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Pétunia, Grabouillon et Bagout vivent mille aventures dans le jardin : chasse aux étoiles filantes, courses sur glace, réparations de niche ratées, courses d'escargots folles… Malgré les bêtises et les imprévus, leur amitié les aide toujours à s'en sortir, avec humour et complicité.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon se blesse et doit porter une collerette, ce qui le rend grognon. Il échange avec Bagout pour se gratter, mais doit patienter. Ensuite, il fait tomber une lettre précieuse, qu'il remplace maladroitement. Il craint aussi le vaccin, cache son carnet, puis découvre que c'est pour Pétunia. Enfin, un yaourt périmé cause une course-poursuite avec la taupe.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Les copains échangent leurs vieux jouets, mais le troc tourne au casse-tête. Sur demande de la maîtresse, ils créent un journal de l'école. Tous privilégient des reportages sur la nature, sauf Rien-Ne-Sert qui invente une histoire d'amour entre Frou-Frou et Ni-Oui. Lulu devra ruser pour le faire changer d'avis et rétablir la vérité.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Rien-Ne-Sert offre un cadeau à Lulu, qui ne lui plaît pas, mais elle n'ose pas le dire. Le malentendu grandit, et RNS en veut à Lulu. Comment vont-ils se réconcilier ? Inspiré par le stéthoscope qui écoute la sève des arbres, RNS veut écouter le cœur de Lulu… mais il lui faut le stéthoscope pour ça.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Rien-Ne-Sert perd la montre que Lulu lui a prêtée. Pour cacher cela, il fait croire qu'il a perdu la mémoire. Ses amis s'activent pour l'aider, mais RNS comprend que mentir n'est pas la solution. Pendant ce temps, ils tournent un film de pirates, Lulu joue la princesse et RNS regrette de ne pas avoir participé.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger
programme.desc: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger - Pingu voit dans un livre une tour qui monte jusqu'au ciel et veut en construire une identique. | Pinga découvre un livre sur les royaumes et Pingu pense que ce serait génial d'être roi. | Pingu veut faire son propre gâteau.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu - Le bras de l'ours de Pinga se détache quand Pingu joue avec. | Pingu part à pied aider grand-père à cause des retards de la motoneige. | Pingu trébuche sur ses jouets, fait un mauvais trajet jusqu'à l'école et ne sait pas répondre au maître.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E9 Pingu perd le pari | Pingu et sa coupe | La carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi
programme.desc: S2:E9 Pingu perd le pari | Pingu et sa coupe | La carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi - Pour se montrer, Pingu parie avec Pinga qu'il est meilleur qu'elle pour viser une boîte avec des balles. | Pingu est très mauvais lors de sa journée sportive. En aidant un ami lors de la dernière épreuve, Pingu gagne le premier prix. | Pingu est ravi de recevoir une carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E10 Pinga somnambule | Pingu fait des bonds | Le lapin perdu de Pinga
programme.desc: S2:E10 Pinga somnambule | Pingu fait des bonds | Le lapin perdu de Pinga - Pingu doit surveiller Pinga lorsqu'elle marche en dormant hors de l'igloo et traverse les maisons des autres. | Pingu rebondit sur tout dans l'igloo, de son lit aux fauteuils. | Pingu taquine sa sœur et son lapin en peluche préféré tombe par la fenêtre.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E11 Le jour venteux de Pingu | Pingu veut voler | Pingu creuse un trou
programme.desc: S2:E11 Le jour venteux de Pingu | Pingu veut voler | Pingu creuse un trou - Pingu et Pinga étendent le linge. Quand une grosse rafale de vent emporte les serviettes, ils se lancent à leur poursuite. | Regarder une mouette voler donne envie à Pingu de voler. | Après que papa a déneigé son chariot, Pingu s'amuse un peu à creuser lui-même.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E12 Pingu finit le travail | Robby le snowboarder | L'aventure lunaire de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E12 Pingu finit le travail | Robby le snowboarder | L'aventure lunaire de Pingu - Papa essaie de fabriquer une table mais passe son temps à éloigner Pingu de sa boîte à outils. | Pingu fait du snowboard avec Robby et souhaite être aussi doué pour les sauts que son ami. | Grand-père parle de la lune à Pingu, qui veut désespérément s'y rendre.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E13 Pingu et Pinga font du camping | Pinga a le hoquet | Tel père, tel Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E13 Pingu et Pinga font du camping | Pinga a le hoquet | Tel père, tel Pingu - Pingu et Pinga dorment sous une tente et Pingu essaie de lui faire peur. | Pinga a le hoquet et Pingu essaie de le faire partir en l'effrayant. | Pingu accompagne papa à la pêche et découvre que papa ne sait pas tout.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E14 Les sculptures de glace de Pingu | Le ballon de Pinga | Pingu et le groupe
programme.desc: S2:E14 Les sculptures de glace de Pingu | Le ballon de Pinga | Pingu et le groupe - Tout le monde participe au concours de glace, sauf Pingu. | Pingu et papa essaient de gonfler un ballon, mais c'est dur. | Pingu et Pinga rendent maman folle en utilisant tout comme tambour.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E15 Pingu et la machine à tricoter | Les ombres du soir de Pingu | Pingu joue à chat
programme.desc: S2:E15 Pingu et la machine à tricoter | Les ombres du soir de Pingu | Pingu joue à chat - Pingu veut utiliser la machine à tricoter de maman. Quand elle se repose, il en profite pour tricoter à toute vitesse ! | C'est l'heure du coucher, mais Pingu et Pinga jouent encore dehors. | Pingu et Pinga jouent à chat. Pingu croit s'être échappé, mais il se retrouve coincé.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu - Pingu et Pinga trouvent des autocollants dans leur boîte de céréales et commencent à étiqueter des objets. | Pingu sait qu'il a des ennuis quand il casse la sonnette de l'igloo. | Robby est extrêmement doué pour faire tenir un poisson en équilibre sur le bout de son nez.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E17 Pingu se perd | Les crêpes de Pingu | Pingu qui pue

programme.title: Plein les yeux
programme.desc: Freddie est frustré de n'être qu'un technicien. Il rêve de participer à l'aspect artistique de l'émission. Carly devant s'absenter pour le week-end, Sam accepte à contrecoeur de le laisser présenter iCarly avec elle.

programme.title: Christopher Cane présente
programme.desc: Christopher Cane (l'acteur anglais qui joue le rôle de Rex dans Victorious) reçoit l'équipe d'iCarly dans son émission.

programme.title: Lépidémie One Direction
programme.desc: Carly attrape une maladie contagieuse et contamine un membre des One Direction accidentellement.

programme.title: Le restaurant
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de Sam, Gibby ouvre un restaurant secret dans le sous-sol de l'école.

programme.title: Poisson davril
programme.desc: Carly et Spencer évoquent les événements du passé, alors qu'ils sont sur le point d'être renvoyés le jour du Poisson d'avril.

programme.title: Pear Store
programme.desc: Freddie obtient un emploi dans un magasin Pear, mais Sam obtient le même poste.

programme.title: Demilloween
programme.desc: iCarly célèbre Demilloween, un nouvel événement inventé par Carly quand elle annonce la tenue d'une fête!

programme.title: Chip la terreur
programme.desc: Spencer se bat contre le frère de Chuck, Chip.

programme.title: Banni
programme.desc: Les intrusions intempestives de Ti-bo dans l'appartement de Spencer et de Carly agacent cette dernière au point qu'elle lui en interdit l'accès. Le voilà banni des lieux ! Pour se venger, il en fait de même avec Carly et la bannit du Smoothie Groovy.

programme.title: Jai perdu ma tête à Vegas
programme.desc: La mère de Sam a été arrêtée à Las Vegas. Sam va devoir trouver deux mille cinq cent dollars pour payer la caution. Toute l'équipe part donc pour Vegas.

programme.title: Sauvez Carly
programme.desc: Sam retrouve Dana, une amie qui vient de sortir de prison. Elle présente Carly à cette amie, qui l'invite à une fête. Carly se rend à cette fête, mais les relations avec Dana restent difficiles du fait de leur caractère.

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: Des amis pour Spencer
programme.desc: En faisant la liste des invités pour l'anniversaire de Spencer, Carly et ses amis se rendent compte qu'il n'a pas d'amis de son âge. Ils se donnent alors pour mission de lui en trouver.

programme.title: Le vol
programme.desc: Sam a perdu son ordinateur portable. Carly et Freddie tentent de l'aider à le chercher. Spencer retrouve des tickets du Funk E. Fester's et décide de remporter le plus gros lot, Murray, le dauphin magique.

programme.title: Le Maître du jeu
programme.desc: La nouvelle passion du jeune Ivan Drago pour les jeux de société le propulse dans le monde fantastique et compétitif de l'invention de jeux, et l'oppose à l'inventeur Morodian, qui désire depuis longtemps détruire la ville de Zyl, fondée par le grand-père d'Ivan.

programme.title: Ursli, l'enfant des montagnes
programme.desc: Un garçon doit braver la neige profonde de l'hiver pour obtenir un précieux souvenir de famille. Avant même de pouvoir commencer ce difficile voyage, il doit d'abord aider sa famille à survivre à la ruine financière, sauver sa chèvre bien-aimée...

programme.title: Fabuleuses Aventures à Oz
programme.desc: La jeune Dorothée part pour le monde de OZ avec un groupe d'amis.

programme.title: La petite princesse et le dragon
programme.desc: Le jour de ses 7 ans, la Princesse Barbara découvre un livre magique qui la transporte dans un univers merveilleux rempli de créatures fantastiques.

programme.title: Au Secours ! J'ai rétréci mes amis
programme.desc: Pour protéger ses objets magiques, Otto Leonhard a enseigné à Félix l'art secret du rétrécissement. Ses amis ayant failli gâcher son rendez-vous avec Mélanie, Félix les réduit instantanément à un dixième de leur taille.

programme.title: L'Ingénieur
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie. Yahya Ayyash, surnommé "l'ingénieur", organise des vagues d'attentats-suicides en Israël au milieu des années 1990. La plus grande des chasses à l'homme de l'histoire du pays se met en place pour le retrouver.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Après avoir planifié le casse "parfait", Nick Mullins est trahi et laissé pour mort par ses partenaires. Il survit et décide de se tourner vers les personnes qu'il a essayé de voler pour l'aider à se venger.

programme.title: Le Commando
programme.desc: Un agent de la DEA doit protéger sa famille contre un criminel, récemment libéré, et ses hommes à la recherche d'une cachette où des millions de dollars seraient dissimulés : au sein même de la maison de l'agent...

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: Nicolas Shaw fait partie d'une équipe d'élite secrète qui élimine les pires tueurs du monde. Après avoir été accusé de l'assassinat d'un membre de son équipe, il doit laver son nom et empêcher le meurtre des autres agents...

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: 1850, entre le Texas et le Nouveau Mexique. À Bright Hope, une horde d'Indiens kidnappe des habitants. Le shérif et ses hommes partent en quête pour les sauver.

programme.title: Fausse piste
programme.desc: Hongrie, années 60. Après une série de meurtres, Martfű est sous le choc. Un innocent est condamné, tandis qu'un tueur psychotique rôde. L'inspecteur, sous pression, doit vite résoudre l'affaire.

programme.title: King rising 3
programme.desc: Hazen Kaine, ex-tueur à gages, accepte une dernière mission avant de se retirer. Mais tout dérape, et il se retrouve au temps médiéval, forcé d'affronter chevaliers et dragons pour survivre.

programme.title: Extraordinary Tales
programme.desc: Cinq histoires, cinq ambiances graphiques différentes, grâce auxquelles les artistes ont exprimé au mieux la complexité et la noirceur de l'univers d'Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Le Repos des braves
programme.desc: Arrivés au terme de leur périple à travers les Alpes, de vieux cyclystes amateurs goûtent un repos bien mérité sur une plage du sud de la France. Ils s'y remémorent leurs exploits, aussi dérisoires qu'essentiels.

programme.title: Jardin des deux rives
programme.desc: A la croisée de Roubaix, Tourcoing et Wattrelos se trouve le quartier de l'Union, une vaste friche de 30 hectares. “Jardin des deux rives” part à la rencontre des voix de ses derniers habitants. C'est une autre voix qiu nous accompagne dans les rues désertées, en murmurant des poèmes de Mahmoud Darwich.

programme.title: La Cinémamecque
programme.desc: La Cinémamecque est une série de courts métrages en stop motion, une histoire du cinéma modelée, animée et analysée et un ciné-club.

programme.title: Diagnostic
programme.desc: Le Dr Semyc est un spécialiste d'une maladie très répandue pour laquelle il n'existe aucun traitement à ce jour. Annoncer le diagnostic est donc un exercice délicat qu'il maitrise cependant à la perfection.

programme.title: Split time
programme.desc: Un homme, une femme. La trentaine. Séduisants et rêveurs. Célibataires. Ils se croisent un milliards de fois sans se rencontrer. Ils sont pourtant faits l'un pour l'autre.

programme.title: Petite mort
programme.desc: Cinq hommes se confient et nous parlent de leurs expériences sexuelles.

programme.title: Le môme Tintouin
programme.desc: Le môme Tintouin est atteint d'un mal dont on n'a pas idée. Le moindre acte de la vie quotidienne est un problème. A l'intérieur de ce crâne fragile tout ne tient qu'à un fil. Les phobies, les voix intérieures dissonantes, le poussent dans ses derniers retranchements. La tendance est de dire qu'il travaille du chapeau mais de toute évidence, le môme Tintouin ne sait plus où donner de la tête.

programme.title: Je sens le beat qui monte en moi
programme.desc: Rosalba, jeune guide touristique, souffre d'une affection étrange : la moindre mélodie provoque chez elle gesticulation et danse de façon aussi subtile qu'incontrôlable. Malgré ses ruses pour cacher son excentricité, ce corps indomptable pourrait bien séduire son surprenant collègue Alain...

programme.title: Rocambolesque
programme.desc: Au milieu du XIXe siècle, face à un éditeur qui refuse obstinément de l'augmenter, que peut bien faire le jeune auteur Ponson du Terrail… si ce n'est mettre dans la balance le destin de Rocambole, le héros de son feuilleton quotidien ?

programme.title: 2 minutes 30
programme.desc: Syrie, 2011. Nour passe le soir de Noël dans un appartement d'Homs avec un groupe de journalistes. Cette jeune pigiste française manque d'argent et veut sortir pour travailler. Mais dehors, c'est la guerre

programme.title: Trop de bruits qui courent
programme.desc: Evry, novembre 2015, quelques jours après les attentats de Paris. Ryad, seize ans,« n'assume pas » sa copine Sabrina: il a honte de se montrer amoureux devant ses copains du quartier. Le vol d'une vidéo sur son portable va pourtant le pousser à changer.

programme.title: Belle à jamais
programme.desc: Ville : Yaoundé. Adresse : Etoudi, carrefour du palais. C'est en arrivant dans cette maison où j'allais vivre pendant cinq semaines que j'ai décidé de filmer ses habitants : Dolvie, Daniella, Gaelle, Mirabelle, Raphaella, Ingrid, Sophie et Loic. Tous vivent chez Honorine, mais seule Gaelle est sa « vraie » fille. Pourtant ici, tout le monde appelle Honorine « maman ».

programme.title: La table
programme.desc: Un menuisier perfectionniste est obsédé par l'idée de créer un objet idéal.

programme.title: Petit homme
programme.desc: En plein nuit, Marc part furieux au volant de sa voiture.

programme.title: Iceberg
programme.desc: M. Elys travaille depuis vingt ans dans une patinoire où il a élu domicile. Il mène une vie sans but au volant de sa surfateuse à glace. Jusqu'au jour où il se heurte à Brie, une gamine farouche et obstinée.Il va lui ouvrir les portes de la patinoire sans se douter des conséquences.

programme.title: Ce qui nous éloigne
programme.desc: Après une longue séparation, une rencontre. Deux familles. Un enfant.

programme.title: Flirt
programme.desc: Quentin et son meilleur ami, Antoine, entrent en classe de troisième. Quentin a une copine. Chloé. Celle-ci ne laisse pas insensible Thomas, le petit caïd du collège. Le monde de l'enfance se fissure définitivement pour Quentin.

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l'établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l'aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l'alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l'empire criminel d'Ik-ho.

programme.title: La Planète Des Requins
programme.desc: Dans une futur proche, la glace a recouvert 98% de la Terre. Les requins dominent désormais la planète...

programme.title: Navy Seals Vs. Zombies: The Battle For New Orleans
programme.desc: Une équipe de Navy Seals vit la bataille de leur vie lorsqu'ils tombent face-à-face avec des morts-vivants. Après une épidémie mortelle en Nouvelle-Orléans, les Seals doivent se battre pour leurs vies, et celle de la ville, face à une armée de zombies.

programme.title: Cross Of Fire
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'ascension et de la chute du leader du Ku Klux Klan des années 1920, D.C. Stephenson.

programme.title: Cross Of Fire
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'ascension et de la chute du leader du Ku Klux Klan des années 1920, D.C. Stephenson.

programme.title: Le lit conjugal
programme.desc: À quarante ans, Alfonso épouse la pieuse Régina. Mais son désir insatiable épuise rapidement Alfonso. Lorsqu'elle tombe enceinte, il est mis à l'écart, contraint de vivre loin d'elle et de ne plus la déranger.

programme.title: Lions et agneaux
programme.desc: Dans les montagnes enneigées d'Afghanistan, un hélicoptère de l'armée américaine est abattu par les talibans. Perdus en milieu hostile, les soldats sortis indemnes du crash luttent pour survivre en attendant d'éventuels renforts.

programme.title: Représailles : La traque sauvage
programme.desc: Une femme, ancienne militaire, pourchasse les hommes qui ont enlevé son fils. Elle prend tous les risques pour parvenir à le tirer des griffes des ravisseurs.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: Après un affrontement avec la police britannique, Frankie McGuire, membre de l'IRA, doit quitter l'Irlande pour les États-Unis. Il se cache dans une famille d'origine irlandaise, les O'Meary, dont le père, gagne sa vie en tant que policier.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Clean, un homme au passé criminel, cherche la rédemption après avoir vécu une tragédie personnelle. Il dédie désormais sa vie à sa communauté délaissée et à la sécurité d'une jeune fille qui lui rappelle sa propre fille.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: L'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner et son beau-fils Trent s'infiltrent dans une école d'arts du spectacle pour filles après que Trent ait été témoin d'un meurtre.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit fatidique dans un petit théâtre régional d'Angleterre pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, une troupe d'acteurs met en scène une représentation du "Roi Lear" de Shakespeare. Les bombes pleuvent, les sirènes résonnent, le rideau se lève dans une heure mais l'acteur/directeur "Sir" (Anthony Hopkins) qui interprète Lear est introuvable.

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Tous deux nominés aux Oscars, Ryan Gosling (THE NOTEBOOK) et Michelle Williams (BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN) sont les vedettes de BLUE VALENTINE, une histoire d'amour perdu et retrouvé raconté à travers des moments passés et présents.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: L'histoire de la vie du champion de boxe poids lourds, Muhammad Ali. Suivez les débuts du champion en tant que Cassius Clay, son ascension dans le sport et la politique, notamment son refus controversé de participer à la guerre du Vietnam ainsi que ses retours au combat notoires.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit fatidique dans un petit théâtre régional d'Angleterre pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, une troupe d'acteurs met en scène une représentation du "Roi Lear" de Shakespeare. Les bombes pleuvent, les sirènes résonnent, le rideau se lève dans une heure mais l'acteur/directeur "Sir" (Anthony Hopkins) qui interprète Lear est introuvable.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que le Staying Alive de Tony Manero fait toujours autant fureur. Il se approche maintenant nonchalamment de son plus grand défi : le produire sur la scène de Broadway.

programme.title: 2 Days in the Valley
programme.desc: Si vous vous écartez du droit chemin, vous savez ce qui vous arrivera ? Pour Becky, c'est se réveiller à côté du corps assassiné de son ex-mari.

programme.title: Brazil
programme.desc: Dans un monde rétro-futuriste, un bureaucrate travaillant pour le gouvernement tente de corriger une erreur administrative mais devient rapidement ennemi de l'État malgré lui.

programme.title: Bye Bye Love
programme.desc: New York, 1963. Une chroniqueuse, dont le nouveau roman qui rejette l'amour est couronné de succès, tombe sous le charme d'un journaliste tombeur de ces dames qui décide de la séduire…

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. If they get a second question wrong they have to kneel. And if they get a third question wrong, they are eliminated. 10 contestants compete for one cash prize.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: Little Lovebird & Mr. Know-It-All
programme.desc: This season, Patti Stanger faces the toughest of the tough cases and this week is no exception. Jersey native, Jason Karniol is a poker playing ticket broker who thinks he knows everything. He takes his poker skills into his dating life and actually reads women's “tells”, dismissing them immediately. He performs true-to-type during his love lesson and infuriates Patti by insisting his methods work. Yelling and insults start flying and Patti lays down the law. Jason must stop his ridiculous “Forget-About-It Frank” behavior and get to know women before judging them. But old habits die hard and Jason struggles to follow Patti's rules. Meanwhile, little person Kacy McInturff from “Little Weddings” fame has only known bootie call love her entire adult life. And no one has ever told her they love her… ever! At 39, she feels the clock is ticking and wedding planner, Kacy needs to decide if she'll follow Patti demands, no matter how painful, in order to change the course of her life. Kacy needs to learn how to demand monogamy in her relationship. But this little lovebird has a habit of returning to her old familiar nest regardless of how much she wants things to change. Even the world's best matchmaker might not be able to break these two of their bad habits and help them find true love.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E11
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's summer on New Zealand's Open Bay Islands, and the local population swells. Wily octopus, foraging crayfish and darting penguins are joined by over 4,000 New Zealand fur seals. Masterful divers, they successfully straddle two distinct neighborhoods: beneath the waves, where they play and eat – and these rocky outcrops, where they're born and mate. Mothers balance the demands of nursing pups, mating-keen males, and their own need to efficiently hunt and feed. Everyone here has new mouths to feed, including the scavenging Weka. Unable to fly nor swim, the species was introduced as food for sealers a century ago -- and has been marooned here ever since.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard

programme.title: Stork Army: Women Fighting for the Hargila

But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E04
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E01
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E02
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Sings of Love

programme.title: Video Wonder

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Duniyadari

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.desc: Punjab is the story of Sukhdev, who has just arrived from Canada and tries to buy his friend's land. In the greed of money, he wants his daughter to marry an illiterate man, while on the other hand a guy from Bihar wants to get married with his daughter.

programme.title: HOTHAT SEDIN
programme.desc: Sanjay and Deepa are in love. Sanjay is working in an office. Deepa, after post graduation, is working on a thesis for doctorate, Sanjay always presents a bouquet of flowers (rajani gandha) to Deepa. Deepa is likely to get a job of teaching at Dhaka. She requests Sanjay to accompany her to Dhaka. Sanjay Doesn's agree as he is expecting a promotion. Deepa reaches Dhaka. To her surprise she finds Navin her ex-boy friend receiving her at Dhaka station. On the journey from Dhaka station to Ira's house, Deepa remembers the time when she broke up with Navin.... Deepa ignores the strike called by Navin. Navin warns her that if she attends the classes inspite of his call for a strike it is the end of their relationship. In Dhaka Navin was all attention to her, Unlike Sanjay who was always forgetful and engrossed in his own promotion Navin was meticulous- kept his time and was all attention to Deepa. In Dhaka Deepa forgot the past and fell in love with Navin all over again... Day of Deepa's departure from Dhaka arrives, Navin has already informed Deepa that she is sure to get the job. In kolkata Deepa finds a bunch of flowers from Sanjay in her room. She pines for letter or telephone from Navin but in vain. She hears a voice- Deepa! Deepa turns - Sanjay stands of the door smilling holding a bunch of flowers. She rushes and embraces Sanjay..... Sanjay gets delighted - so you failed to get the job at Dhaka? Don's worry ... I have got promotion, now we can get married!

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26
programme.desc: As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. When pigments needed for overglaze painting run short, Mun Saseung turns to Hwa-ryeong for supplies—drawing Gangcheon straight to her. Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Way Back Home

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam

Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

We will then trade in the cool Baltic region for tropical Caribbean. Here we will prove that it would be wrong to link the Cuban province of Guantanamo only with the famous American naval base. To wrap things up, we will return to Europe's Mediterranean region to visit people of the Lipari Islands who continue to survive in the shade of ever-smouldering volcanoes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven't had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats
programme.sub-title: S01:E01 - The Secret Lives of Tigers
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Siberian tigers are the largest of all cats. In historic times, the tiger's range was vast, covering much of Asia. Over the last century, they've experienced an almost total population crash, and at least 97% of those tigers have gone.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats
programme.sub-title: S01:E02 - The Secret Lives of Snow Leopards
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Often referred to as the gray ghost or ghost of the mountains, this animal's rarity and elusiveness was legendary. In the past, it was known as the ounce, but today we've settled on the name snow leopard.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. Dive with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore as they investigate the impact climate change is having on the ocean, explore engineering ideas for artificial reefs, and discover a coral species showing resilience to climate change.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia
programme.sub-title: S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: Animals or groups protect their territory by using sounds like birds singing or scents like pheromones from many mammals to mark boundaries. These are just the initial warnings. If other animals ignore these signs, a conflict might happen. Animals need a secure territory to mate, raise their young, and ensure there's enough food and resources for survival. This episode looks at the strategies animals use to claim their territory.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature
programme.desc: In this episode we visit two different corners of our planet. Although thousands of kilometres apart, spiritually they are close relatives. programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.
